title: Computing Machinery and Intelligence
short: Alan Turing publishes the paper that frames the modern question of machine intelligence and proposes what became known as the Turing Test.

title: Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence
short: The Dartmouth workshop convenes, popularizing the term 'artificial intelligence' and becoming a foundational milestone for AI as a field.

title: The Perceptron
short: Frank Rosenblatt publishes the Perceptron, an early trainable model that shaped the neural-network lineage of modern AI.

title: ELIZA
short: Joseph Weizenbaum publishes ELIZA, an early conversational program that popularizes the idea of human-like dialog with computers.

title: Learning representations by back-propagating errors
short: Rumelhart, Hinton, and Williams publish a widely influential account of backpropagation, accelerating practical training of neural networks.

title: ImageNet Dataset Introduced
short: Researchers introduce ImageNet, helping standardize large-scale vision benchmarking and accelerating dataset-driven deep learning.

title: Dropout
short: Dropout is introduced as a simple stochastic regularization technique that improves generalization in neural networks.

title: Generative Adversarial Networks
short: Goodfellow and colleagues introduce GANs, framing generative modeling as a game between a generator and a discriminator.

title: Neural Machine Translation with Attention
short: Bahdanau, Cho, and Bengio propose an attention mechanism for neural machine translation, improving sequence-to-sequence modeling.

title: Batch Normalization
short: Ioffe and Szegedy introduce Batch Normalization, improving training stability and speed for deep networks.

title: TensorFlow Open-Sourced
short: Google open-sources TensorFlow, accelerating the spread of scalable deep learning tooling in research and industry.

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
short: He and colleagues introduce residual connections, enabling very deep networks and influencing modern architecture design.

title: Attention Is All You Need
short: Google researchers introduce the Transformer architecture, replacing recurrence with self-attention and revolutionizing NLP and beyond.

title: ONNX Announced
short: Facebook and Microsoft announce ONNX to improve interoperability of deep learning models across frameworks and tooling.

title: GPT-1
short: OpenAI releases GPT-1, demonstrating that generative pre-training on unlabeled text followed by fine-tuning can achieve strong NLP performance.

title: BERT
short: Google introduces BERT, a bidirectional Transformer model that achieves breakthrough results across NLP benchmarks and transforms the field.

title: PyTorch 1.0 Stable Release
short: PyTorch 1.0 ships as a stable release, strengthening the framework’s role from research prototyping to production.

title: GPT-2
short: OpenAI releases GPT-2, a 1.5B parameter model capable of generating coherent long-form text, initially withheld over misuse concerns.

title: GPT-3
short: OpenAI unveils GPT-3 with 175 billion parameters, demonstrating remarkable few-shot learning abilities and launching the era of large language models.

title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
short: Ho, Jain, and Abbeel publish DDPM, helping establish diffusion as a leading approach to high-quality image generation.

title: AlphaFold 2
short: DeepMind's AlphaFold 2 solves the protein structure prediction problem at CASP14, achieving accuracy comparable to experimental methods.

title: CLIP: Connecting Text and Images
short: OpenAI introduces CLIP, a contrastive multimodal model that enables strong zero-shot image recognition from natural language prompts.

title: DALL·E
short: OpenAI introduces DALL·E, a 12-billion parameter model that generates images from text descriptions, opening the era of text-to-image AI.

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
short: LoRA introduces a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique by injecting low-rank adapters into frozen pretrained models.

title: GitHub Copilot
short: GitHub launches Copilot, an AI pair programmer powered by OpenAI Codex that autocompletes code in real time within IDEs.

title: OpenAI Codex
short: OpenAI releases Codex, a GPT-3 descendant fine-tuned on code that powers GitHub Copilot and can translate natural language to programming code.

title: InstructGPT and RLHF
short: OpenAI publishes InstructGPT, showing that fine-tuning with human feedback can make models more helpful even at smaller sizes.

title: DALL·E 2
short: OpenAI unveils DALL·E 2, producing photorealistic images from text at 1024×1024 resolution using diffusion models and CLIP guidance.

title: FlashAttention
short: FlashAttention is introduced as an IO-aware exact attention algorithm that improves speed and memory efficiency for Transformers.

title: Stable Diffusion
short: Stability AI releases Stable Diffusion as open source, democratizing high-quality text-to-image generation and igniting the open generative AI movement.

title: Whisper
short: OpenAI releases Whisper, an open-source multilingual speech recognition system trained for robust transcription and translation.

title: ChatGPT Launch
short: OpenAI releases ChatGPT, a conversational AI based on GPT-3.5 with RLHF, sparking mainstream AI adoption and reaching 100 million users in two months.

title: LLaMA (Meta)
short: Meta releases LLaMA, a collection of efficient open-weight language models from 7B to 65B parameters, catalyzing the open-source LLM ecosystem.

title: Cursor (AI Code Editor) Launch
short: Cursor launches as an AI-native code editor built on top of VS Code, reflecting the shift toward agentic developer workflows.

title: llama.cpp Released
short: llama.cpp is released as an open-source C/C++ inference library, accelerating local LLM experimentation via CPU-friendly execution and quantization.

title: GPT-4
short: OpenAI releases GPT-4, a multimodal model that accepts text and image inputs, setting new benchmarks across professional and academic exams.

title: QLoRA
short: QLoRA shows how to fine-tune large models efficiently by combining 4-bit quantization with LoRA-style adapters.

title: Direct Preference Optimization
short: DPO is proposed as a simpler alternative to RLHF by optimizing preference objectives without explicit reinforcement learning.

title: vLLM Introduced
short: The vLLM project is introduced as an open-source library for faster and cheaper LLM serving using PagedAttention.

title: Llama 2
short: Meta releases Llama 2 with a permissive commercial license, providing open-weight models from 7B to 70B parameters and advancing open-source AI.

title: PagedAttention Paper
short: The PagedAttention paper formalizes a KV-cache memory management approach for higher-throughput LLM serving and introduces vLLM.

title: Mistral 7B
short: French startup Mistral AI releases Mistral 7B, an efficient open-source model that outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks.

title: Gemini (Google)
short: Google DeepMind launches Gemini, a natively multimodal AI model family that processes text, images, audio, and video, competing directly with GPT-4.

title: Gemini 1.5
short: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 1.5 Pro with a groundbreaking 1 million token context window, enabling processing of entire codebases and hour-long videos.

title: Sora (OpenAI)
short: OpenAI previews Sora, a text-to-video diffusion model capable of generating photorealistic minute-long videos from text prompts.

title: Claude 3
short: Anthropic releases the Claude 3 model family (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) with vision capabilities, setting new benchmarks in reasoning and safety.

title: Hello GPT-4o
short: OpenAI announces GPT-4o, a multimodal flagship model aimed at real-time interaction across text, vision, and audio.

title: GPT-4o mini
short: OpenAI releases GPT-4o mini, a cost-efficient small model positioned for broad deployment in apps and APIs.

title: Llama 3.1
short: Meta releases Llama 3.1 with models up to 405B parameters under an open license, rivaling closed frontier models and setting a new bar for open-weight AI.

title: Mistral Large 2
short: Mistral AI releases Mistral Large 2, a flagship model emphasizing long context, multilingual performance, and tool/function calling.

title: EU AI Act Enters into Force
short: The European Union’s AI Act enters into force, establishing a comprehensive risk-based regulatory framework for AI systems.

title: Llama 3.2
short: Meta releases Llama 3.2, adding new model variants and expanding the Llama open-weight lineup.

title: Claude Computer Use
short: Anthropic launches Claude computer use in public beta, enabling Claude to interact with desktop environments by viewing screens and controlling mouse and keyboard.

title: o3 (OpenAI)
short: OpenAI announces o3, a reasoning-focused model that achieves breakthrough scores on ARC-AGI and math benchmarks using extended chain-of-thought.

title: DeepSeek R1
short: DeepSeek releases R1, an open-weight reasoning model rivaling OpenAI's o1 at a fraction of the training cost, shaking up the AI industry.

title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet
short: Anthropic releases Claude 3.7 Sonnet, positioning it as a hybrid reasoning model with major improvements in coding and agent tasks.

title: Claude Code (Research Preview)
short: Anthropic introduces Claude Code in a limited research preview, bringing agentic coding workflows into the terminal.

title: GPT-4.5
short: OpenAI releases GPT-4.5, its largest and most knowledge-dense model, emphasizing improved factuality, broader knowledge, and reduced hallucination.

title: Gemma 3
short: Google introduces Gemma 3, a family of lightweight open models derived from Gemini research and designed for on-device or single-accelerator use.

title: Gemini 2.5
short: Google introduces Gemini 2.5 as a thinking model family, emphasizing improved reasoning and coding performance.

title: Llama 4 (Scout and Maverick)
short: Meta releases Llama 4 Scout and Llama 4 Maverick, introducing a new generation of Llama models and previewing a larger Behemoth variant.

title: GPT-4.1
short: OpenAI introduces GPT-4.1 in the API, emphasizing coding gains, instruction following, and up to 1M-token context.

title: OpenAI o3 and o4-mini
short: OpenAI introduces o3 and o4-mini as reasoning-focused models with full tool access for agentic workflows.

title: Introducing Codex
short: OpenAI launches Codex, a cloud-based software engineering agent that can run parallel tasks and propose PRs.

title: Claude 4 Sonnet
short: Anthropic releases Claude 4 Sonnet, a frontier model excelling at coding, agentic tasks, and extended thinking, powering a new generation of AI tools.

title: Grok 4
short: xAI releases Grok 4, emphasizing native tool use and real-time search integration for up-to-date answers.

title: GPT-5
short: OpenAI releases GPT-5, positioning it as a flagship model with built-in thinking for faster and more reliable performance.

title: Introducing upgrades to Codex
short: OpenAI ships major Codex upgrades, focusing on reliability, collaboration, and agentic work across development surfaces.

title: Grok 4 Fast
short: xAI releases Grok 4 Fast, aiming for lower-cost reasoning with strong search and long-context capabilities.

title: Claude Code autonomy upgrades
short: Anthropic upgrades Claude Code with a native VS Code extension, a v2 terminal experience, and checkpoints for autonomous work.

title: Claude Sonnet 4.5
short: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 4.5, emphasizing agent building, coding strength, and computer-use capabilities.

title: Claude Haiku 4.5
short: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 4.5, positioning it as a fast, cost-efficient model with near-frontier capability for many tasks.

title: OpenClaw (initial release as Clawd/Clawdbot)
short: OpenClaw begins as an open-source personal AI assistant project (initially branded Clawd/Clawdbot), launching in November 2025.

title: GPT-5.1
short: OpenAI releases GPT-5.1, upgrading the GPT-5 series and rolling it out to ChatGPT users in phases.

title: Grok 4.1
short: xAI releases Grok 4.1, describing improvements in real-world usability and a staged silent rollout process.

title: Gemini 3
short: Google releases Gemini 3, positioning it as a new flagship generation with stronger reasoning and multimodal capabilities.

title: Google Antigravity (public preview)
short: Google introduces Antigravity, an agentic development platform to manage coding agents across editor, terminal, and browser workflows.

title: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max
short: OpenAI introduces GPT-5.1-Codex-Max, a frontier agentic coding model built for long-running tasks via compaction.

title: Claude Opus 4.5
short: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.5 as a top-tier model, alongside updates to Claude’s developer platform and apps.

title: Gemini 3 Deep Think
short: Google rolls out Gemini 3 Deep Think mode to Ultra subscribers, emphasizing improved performance on complex reasoning tasks.

title: Devstral 2
short: Mistral releases Devstral 2, a frontier coding model designed for agentic workflows over real codebases.

title: GPT-5.2
short: OpenAI releases GPT-5.2, emphasizing stronger long-context understanding, agentic tool use, and improved real-world task execution.

title: Gemini 3 Flash
short: Google releases Gemini 3 Flash, expanding the Gemini 3 family with a faster model designed for broad product deployment.

title: GPT-5.2-Codex
short: OpenAI releases GPT-5.2-Codex, an agentic coding model optimized for long-horizon software engineering and defensive cybersecurity.

title: Cowork (Research Preview)
short: Anthropic introduces Cowork in research preview, extending Claude Code-style agentic workflows beyond coding to general knowledge work.

title: Agentic Vision in Gemini 3 Flash
short: Google introduces Agentic Vision in Gemini 3 Flash, enabling step-by-step visual investigation grounded with code execution.

title: Codex app for macOS
short: OpenAI launches the Codex macOS app, positioning it as a command center for managing multiple agents and long-running tasks.

title: Claude Opus 4.6
short: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.6, highlighting stronger coding, longer agentic tasks, and a 1M-token context window (beta).

title: GPT-5.3-Codex
short: OpenAI releases GPT-5.3-Codex, extending Codex toward broader computer-based professional workflows beyond code generation.

title: China Issues Security Warning on OpenClaw Deployments
short: Chinese authorities issue a warning about security risks tied to OpenClaw deployments, highlighting the governance challenges of fast-growing agent platforms.

title: Aletheia: Towards Autonomous Mathematics Research
short: Google researchers publish Aletheia, an agent that generates, verifies and revises solutions to research-level mathematics problems.

title: GLM-5
short: Z.ai releases GLM-5, an open-weight model built for complex software engineering and long-horizon agent tasks.

title: OpenAI clarifies timeline for secret AI hardware device
short: OpenAI sets launch timeline for its secret AI device in 2027, marking expansion into dedicated hardware.

title: GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark Research Preview
short: OpenAI previews Codex-Spark, a text-only coding model served on Cerebras hardware for low-latency interaction.

title: ByteDance Officially Introduces Seedance 2.0
short: ByteDance introduces Seedance 2.0, combining text, image, audio, and video references for joint audiovisual generation.

title: UN Appoints Its Independent International Scientific Panel on AI
short: The UN General Assembly appoints 40 experts to its independent scientific panel on AI.

title: Qwen3.5
short: Alibaba releases Qwen3.5, combining native vision-language modeling with hybrid attention and sparse experts.

title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview
short: Google releases Gemini 3.1 Pro in preview and begins rolling it out across consumer and developer products.

title: Perplexity Computer Launches
short: Perplexity launches Computer for Max subscribers to execute long-running workflows across apps, files, and the web.

title: FlashAttention-4 Paper and FlexAttention Integration
short: FlashAttention-4's technical paper and PyTorch integration describe attention kernels optimized for modern GPU bottlenecks.

title: GPT-5.4
short: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4, combining general reasoning, coding, and native computer use in one model.

title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super
short: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3 Super with hybrid Mamba-attention architecture, open weights and training resources.

title: Mistral Small 4
short: Mistral releases Small 4, unifying instruction following, reasoning, visual input and agentic coding under Apache 2.0.

title: Voxtral TTS
short: Mistral launches Voxtral TTS and publishes a reference-voice model under the noncommercial CC BY-NC 4.0 license.

title: TwELL: Hardware-Efficient Sparse Transformer Computation
short: Sakana AI and NVIDIA introduce TwELL storage and CUDA kernels that turn sparse transformer activations into practical efficiency gains.

title: Gemma 4
short: Google releases Gemma 4 in four sizes, with multimodal inputs, reasoning capabilities and Apache 2.0 model weights.

title: Claude Mythos Preview and Project Glasswing
short: Anthropic announces Mythos Preview with restricted access through the defensive-security initiative Project Glasswing.

title: Claude Managed Agents Enters Public Beta
short: Anthropic releases Claude Managed Agents in public beta, providing hosted infrastructure for long-running agents.

title: Meta Muse Spark
short: Meta launches Muse Spark in Meta AI, introducing its new multimodal reasoning family and a private API preview.

title: China Issues Rules for AI Emotional Companions
short: China issues national rules governing persistent emotional interaction with anthropomorphic AI services.

title: Physical Intelligence presents pi0.7, a steerable robot foundation model
short: Physical Intelligence presents pi0.7, using richer context to steer robot behavior and transfer skills across embodiments.

title: ChatGPT Images 2.0 and Thinking Mode
short: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Images 2.0 with a thinking mode that brings reasoning and tools into image generation.

title: Decoupled DiLoCo for Resilient Distributed Pre-training
short: Google DeepMind introduces asynchronous training across independent compute groups to isolate failures and reduce synchronization stalls.

title: GPT-5.5
short: OpenAI starts rolling out GPT-5.5 for coding, computer use, knowledge work, and scientific workflows.

title: DeepSeek V4 Preview
short: DeepSeek releases V4 Pro and Flash previews with downloadable weights and one-million-token context support.

title: Gemini 3.5 Flash
short: Google launches Gemini 3.5 Flash and makes it the default in Gemini and AI Mode in Search.

title: Gemini Omni Flash
short: Google begins rolling out Omni Flash, combining multimodal inputs with conversational video generation and editing.

title: Google Announces Gemini Spark
short: Google announces Gemini Spark, a persistent personal agent built on Gemini 3.5 and the Antigravity harness.

title: Gated DeltaNet-2 Decouples Memory Erasing and Writing
short: Gated DeltaNet-2 introduces separate channel-wise erase and write gates for more expressive recurrent memory updates.

title: Biohub Releases ESMFold2 and the Expanded ESM Atlas
short: Biohub releases protein modeling tools and an ESM Atlas spanning 6.8 billion sequences and 1.1 billion predicted structures.

title: MiniMax M3
short: MiniMax launches M3 with native image and video input, agentic workflows and a one-million-token context window.

title: US Orders Frontier AI Cybersecurity Assessments and Voluntary Early Access
short: Executive Order 14409 directs frontier-model cyber assessments and a voluntary government early-access framework.

title: Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
short: Anthropic launches Fable 5 for general use and Mythos 5 with restricted access, sharing one underlying model.

title: GLM-5.2
short: Z.ai launches GLM-5.2 with one-million-token context and IndexShare for more efficient sparse attention.

title: EU Adopts AI Act Amendments and Delays High-Risk Requirements
short: The EU adopts AI Act amendments postponing high-risk requirements and adding a prohibition on sexual deepfake systems.

title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Work
short: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Work, extending agentic execution across apps, files, and finished workplace deliverables.

title: GPT-5.6: Sol, Terra, and Luna
short: OpenAI makes the GPT-5.6 family generally available after a limited preview, with Sol, Terra, and Luna models.

title: Kimi K3
short: Moonshot launches Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter multimodal model; its weights follow on July 27.

title: Claude Opus 5
short: Anthropic releases Opus 5, bringing its new model generation to everyday coding and knowledge work.

title: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2
short: Gemini Robotics 2 adds whole-body humanoid control, dexterous manipulation and multi-robot coordination.

title: EU AI Act Transparency Duties and Enforcement Powers Take Effect
short: EU AI Act transparency duties and enforcement powers become applicable, including oversight of general-purpose AI models.

title: MiniMax H3 Open-Weight Release
short: MiniMax publishes H3-Base checkpoints for multimodal-conditioned video and stereo-audio generation.

title: Meta Muse Glimmer
short: Meta releases Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter multimodal model for local agents, under Apache 2.0.

title: Qwen3.8 Max-Class Open Weights
short: Alibaba publishes Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, bringing its Max-class model line to downloadable weights.

title: MiniMax Music 3.0
short: MiniMax introduces Music 3.0 for generating complete songs of up to five minutes from concepts and optional lyrics.

title: World Labs Introduces Atlas for Spatial World Modeling
short: World Labs introduces Atlas, a multimodal world model with camera-conditioned generation and explicit 3D outputs.

title: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber
short: Google releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and introduces Flash Cyber for trusted defenders through Fairwind.

title: GPT-6 Astra Initial Rollout
short: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Astra and starts a limited rollout of its new frontier model generation.

title: AlphaGenome Atlas Maps Predicted Effects of Nine Billion DNA Variants
short: AlphaGenome Atlas releases genome-wide molecular-effect predictions for roughly nine billion possible single-nucleotide variants.

title: Meta Launches Muse Personal AI Agent
short: Meta launches Muse, a personal agent with a dedicated cloud VM, persistent work, and an independent permission system.

title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
short: DeepSeek launches V4.1 Flash with native vision and an asymmetric architecture designed to reduce long-context serving costs.

title: Apple Begins Siri AI Public Beta Rollout
short: Apple begins rolling out Siri AI in English beta across supported devices with its 2027 operating-system releases.

title: Claude Opus 5.5
short: Anthropic introduces Opus 5.5 with lower token prices and revised safeguards for advanced professional work.

title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna
short: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Sol and Luna through its API, ChatGPT Work, and Codex.

title: OpenAI Launches Dots
short: OpenAI begins rolling out Dots, always-on agents powered by GPT-6 Astra with their own cloud computers.

title: Gemini 4 Argon Limited Rollout
short: Google announces Gemini 4 Argon and begins a limited rollout to trusted cyber defenders through Fairwind.

title: SynthID Bio Extends AI Watermarking to Protein Designs
short: Google DeepMind presents watermarking methods for AI-designed protein sequences and predicted structures, with laboratory validation.

title: Mistral Large 4 Public Preview
short: Mistral opens a public API preview of Large 4, a trillion-parameter multimodal model trained in European datacenters.

title: OpenAI Releases a Public Collection of AI-Generated Mathematical Manuscripts
short: OpenAI publishes mathematical manuscripts, selected reasoning summaries and partial Lean formalizations from an internal model.

title: Microsoft Execution Containers Becomes Generally Available
short: Microsoft makes Execution Containers generally available to enforce policy boundaries around AI agent workloads.
